blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Hydrocarbons) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the classification of hydrocarbons into aliphatic and aromatic classes. Name the families of aliphatic hydrocarbons with one example of each. (4 marks)
(Hydrocarbons ki aliphatic aur aromatic qismon mein darja-bandi bayan karein. Aliphatic hydrocarbons ki families aur har aik ki aik misaal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrocarbons sirf carbon aur hydrogen ke organic compounds hain jo petroleum aur natural gas mein bohat milte hain. Inhein do bari qismon mein baanta jata hai.

1. Aliphatic hydrocarbons: woh compounds jo aromatic nahi. Yeh open chain ya cyclic, saturated ya unsaturated ho sakte hain.
• Alkanes: acyclic, saturated, CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, maslan ethane CH₃–CH₃.
• Cycloalkanes: cyclic, saturated, maslan cyclohexane.
• Alkenes: acyclic, unsaturated (C=C), maslan ethene CH₂=CH₂.
• Alkynes: acyclic, unsaturated (triple bond).

2. Aromatic hydrocarbons: cyclic hydrocarbons ki khaas qisam jin mein carbon ka hydrogen se ratio ziyada hai aur jo benzene (C₆H₆) ya us jaise compounds par mabni hain. Benzene bunyaadi aromatic compound hai; toluene aur phenol is ke derivatives hain. Naam Greek 'aroma' (khushbu-daar) se hai kyun ke in ki khaas boo hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons are broadly divided into two classes that is aliphatic and aromatic hydrocarbons.

blocks.prompt:
2 What is an alkyl group? How are alkyl groups named? Write the alkyl groups that can be derived from propane and butane with their common and IUPAC names. (4 marks)
(Alkyl group kya hai? Alkyl groups ke naam kaise rakhe jate hain? Propane aur butane se banne wale alkyl groups ke aam aur IUPAC naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alkyl group: alkane se aik hydrogen atom hatane par jo milta hai. Is ka naam alkane ke -ane ko -yl se badal kar rakha jata hai: methane CH₄ → methyl CH₃– (Me–); ethane → ethyl CH₃CH₂– (Et–).

Do se ziyada carbon wale alkanes se aik se ziyada alkyl groups bante hain, is par munhasir ke kaun sa hydrogen hataya gaya (Table 11.3):

book_ref.quote: What we obtain after the removal of one hydrogen atom from an alkane is called an alkyl group.

blocks.prompt:
3 State and explain the first four IUPAC rules for naming branched-chain alkanes, giving an example for each. (4 marks)
(Branched-chain alkanes ke naam rakhne ke pehle chaar IUPAC rules bayan karein aur har aik ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Rule 1: carbon atoms ki sab se lambi musalsal chain dhoondein; yehi parent name deti hai. Formula mein yeh mudi hui ho sakti hai. Maslan CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ ki chain paanch carbon ki hai: pentane.

Rule 2: lambi chain ki numbering substituent ke qareeb wale sire se karein. Upar ki misaal mein baayen se numbering CH₃ ko C-2 par rakhti hai (C-4 nahi).

Rule 3: in numbers se substituent ki jagah dikhayein. Number ke saath substituent pehle aur parent name aakhir mein: 2-methylpentane; isi tarah 3-methylheptane aur 2-methylhexane.

Rule 4: do ya ziyada substituents hon to har aik ko lambi chain par us ki jagah ka number dein aur unhein alphabetical tarteeb (ethyl pehle methyl) mein likhein, maslan 4-ethyl-2-methylhexane; CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH(C₂H₅)–CH₂–CH₃ ka naam 3-ethyl-2-methylpentane.

book_ref.quote: Branched chain alkanes are named according to the following rules.

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain the IUPAC rules for naming alkanes that (i) have two substituents on the same carbon, (ii) have identical substituents, (iii) have two competing chains of equal length, and (iv) branch at equal distances from both ends. (4 marks)
(Alkanes ke naam ke IUPAC rules samjhayein jab (i) aik carbon par do substituents hon, (ii) aik jaise substituents hon, (iii) barabar lambai ki do chains muqable mein hon, aur (iv) dono siron se barabar faasle par branching ho.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Rule 5: jab aik hi carbon par do substituents hon to woh number do dafa likhein, maslan 3-ethyl-3-methylhexane; CH₃CH₂C(CH₃)₂CH₂CH₃ ka naam 3,3-dimethylpentane.

(ii) Rule 6: jab do ya ziyada substituents aik jaise hon to di, tri, tetra waghera prefixes lagayein aur yaqeeni banayein ke har substituent ka number ho: 2,3-dimethylbutane, 2,3,4-trimethylpentane, 2,2,3,3-tetramethylbutane. Alphabetical tarteeb mein yeh prefixes nazar-andaz hote hain.

(iii) Rule 7: jab barabar lambai ki do chains parent banne ke liye muqable mein hon to ziyada substituents wali chain chunein, maslan 2,3,5-trimethyl-4-propylheptane.

(iv) Rule 8: jab branching dono siron se barabar faasle par shuru ho to woh naam chunein jo pehle farq wali jagah par chhota number de, maslan 2,3,5-trimethylhexane (2,4,5- nahi).

book_ref.quote: Application of these six rules allows us to name most of the alkanes that we shall encounter.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the shapes of alkanes and cycloalkanes. How are cycloalkanes named? (4 marks)
(Alkanes aur cycloalkanes ki shakal bayan karein. Cycloalkanes ke naam kaise rakhe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Alkanes: alkane ke carbon ke chaar sp³ hybrid orbitals hote hain jo aas paas ke carbon aur hydrogen se chaar single (σ) bonds banate hain, aik doosre se barabar faasle par. Chaar bonding pairs barabar dafa karte hain, is liye har carbon ke gird tetrahedral shakal, bond angle 109.5° aur C–C bond length 1.54 Å (methane aur ethane, Figure 11.4). Shakal ball and stick formula se dikhai jati hai (Table 11.4).

Cycloalkanes: carbon atoms ring (halqe) ki shakal mein hote hain. Yeh saturated hain: ring ke saare carbon sirf single bonds se jure hain. Formula CₙH₂ₙ, maslan cyclopropane C₃H₆, cyclobutane C₄H₈, cyclopentane C₅H₁₀ (Table 11.5).

Naam: utne hi carbon wale alkane ke naam se pehle cyclo lagayein, maslan chhe carbon ka ring cyclohexane.

book_ref.quote: Alkane molecules have a tetrahedral shape around carbon atoms.

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the physical properties of alkanes: physical state, colour and odour, solubility, and the trend in boiling points including the effect of branching. (4 marks)
(Alkanes ki physical khasusiyat bayan karein: haalat, rang aur boo, solubility, aur boiling points ka rujhan, branching ke asar samait.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Haalat: chaar carbon tak alkanes gases; pentane se heptadecane (C₅ se C₁₇) liquids; C₁₈ se aage waxy (mom jaise) solids.

2. Rang aur boo: sab be-rang aur be-boo.

3. Solubility: alkanes non-polar ya bohat halke polar hain, is liye water jaise polar solvents mein na-hal magar hexane, benzene aur ether jaise non-polar solvents mein hal. Molecular mass barhne se solubility kam hoti hai.

4. Boiling point waghera: carbon atoms barhne se boiling point, melting point aur density barhte hain. Branched alkanes apne seedhi chain wale isomers se kam par ubalte hain: butane -0.50 °C, magar is ka branched isomer 2-methylpropane (isobutane) -11.7 °C.

book_ref.quote: Their physical constants, e.g. boiling points, melting points, density, etc increase with the increase in number of carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a reaction mechanism? Describe the two modes of breaking a covalent bond, naming the species formed in each, with an example. (4 marks)
(Reaction mechanism kya hai? Covalent bond tootne ke do tareeqe bayan karein, har aik mein banne wali species aur misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction mechanism: woh qadmon ka silsila jo poore reaction ke dauran hota hai. Organic reactions mein covalent bonds tootte hain, jo do tareeqon se hota hai.

(a) Homolytic fission: covalent bond barabar toot-ta hai; har atom shared pair ka aik electron leta hai aur free radicals bante hain (Figure 11.5). Misaal: Cl–Cl → Cl• + Cl• (UV light mein). Free radical mein aik unpaired electron hota hai; yeh bohat reactive hai kyun ke unpaired electrons jora banana chahte hain.

(b) Heterolytic fission: bond aise toot-ta hai ke shared pair sirf aik atom ko milta hai aur mukhalif charge wale ions bante hain. Misaal: R₃C–Cl → R₃C⁺ + Cl⁻, carbocation aur chloride ion (Figure 11.6). Mechanisms mein ise poore curly arrows se dikhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Like all chemical reactions, organic reactions involve the breaking of chemical bonds.

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain why alkanes are called paraffins and why they are unreactive towards polar reagents under ordinary conditions. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke alkanes ko paraffins kyun kehte hain aur aam halaat mein woh polar reagents se react kyun nahi karte.)
blocks.explanation:
Paraffins: Latin parum = thora aur affins = affinity (lagao). Aam halaat mein alkanes acids, alkalis, oxidizing aur reducing agents se react nahi karte.

1. Bonds ki non-polarity: carbon (2.5) aur hydrogen (2.1) ki electronegativity mein sirf 0.4 ka farq hai, is liye C–H aur C–C mein electrons taqreeban barabar share hote hain. Bonds non-polar hain, is liye polar reagents (jo charged jagah par hamla karte hain) ko kuch nahi milta.

2. Sigma bond ki mazbooti: alkanes mein sirf σ bonds hain. σ bond mein electrons nuclei ke darmiyan mazbooti se pakre hote hain, is liye bond bohat mustahkam hai; isse torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye.

Is liye alkanes sirf ziyada temperature ya khaas halaat mein react karte hain, maslan combustion, cracking aur light mein free radical substitution.

book_ref.quote: The lack of reactivity of alkanes under normal conditions may be explained on the basis of the non-polarity of the bonds forming them.

blocks.prompt:
9 Discuss the halogenation of alkanes with respect to: the conditions needed, the effect of the nature of the halogen, the successive products from methane, and the dependence on the amount of halogen. (4 marks)
(Alkanes ki halogenation par in nukaat ke lihaaz se behes karein: zaroori halaat, halogen ki qisam ka asar, methane se silsilewaar products, aur halogen ki miqdaar par inhesaar.)
blocks.explanation:
Halogenation mein alkane ke hydrogen atoms bohat reactive free radicals ke zariye halogen atoms se badalte hain.

1. Halaat: alkanes sunlight ya UV light mein chlorine aur bromine se react karte hain.

2. Halogen ki qisam: reactivity F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂. Fluorine bohat shiddat se react kar ke carbon, fluorinated alkanes aur hydrofluoric acid ka mixture deti hai. Iodine seedha substitution nahi karti kyun ke reaction bohat aahista aur reversible hai.

3. Methane se silsilewaar products:
CH₄ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + HCl (chloromethane)
CH₃Cl + Cl₂ → CH₂Cl₂ + HCl (dichloromethane)
CH₂Cl₂ + Cl₂ → CHCl₃ + HCl (trichloromethane, chloroform)
CHCl₃ + Cl₂ → CCl₄ + HCl (tetrachloromethane, carbon tetrachloride)

4. Halogen ki miqdaar: halogenation ki had istemal hone wali halogen ki miqdaar par munhasir hai; shuru mein jitni ziyada chlorine, chloroalkanes mein chlorine atoms utne ziyada. Haloalkanes behosh karne wale aur zehreele hain, is liye lab mein un ke istemal par sakht nigrani hai.

book_ref.quote: Alkanes react with chlorine and bromine in the presence of sunlight or UV light resulting in the successive replacement of hydrogen atoms with halogens.

blocks.prompt:
10 Write the free radical mechanism for the chlorination of ethane in UV light, showing all three possible termination steps. Which product shows that the mechanism goes through free radicals? (4 marks)
(UV light mein ethane ki chlorination ka free radical mechanism likhein, termination ke teeno mumkin qadmon samait. Kaun sa product dikhata hai ke mechanism free radicals se guzarta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Majmooi: CH₃–CH₃ + Cl₂ → CH₃–CH₂Cl + HCl (UV light).

(i) Initiation: UV light ki energy se Cl–Cl bond homolytically toot-ta hai:
Cl–Cl → Cl• + Cl•

(ii) Propagation: radicals alkane par hamla kar ke mazeed free radicals banate hain:
CH₃–CH₃ + Cl• → CH₃–CH₂• + HCl
CH₃–CH₂• + Cl–Cl → CH₃–CH₂Cl + Cl•
Naya Cl• yeh chakkar dohrata hai; dohrane se chloroethanes ka mixture banta hai.

(iii) Termination: do free radicals mil kar product banate hain:
CH₃–CH₂• + Cl• → CH₃–CH₂Cl
Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂
CH₃–CH₂• + •CH₂–CH₃ → CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (butane)

Saboot: butane mein ethane se dugne carbon hain aur yeh sirf do ethyl radicals ke milne se banti hai. Yeh termination kam hota hai, is liye butane thori miqdaar mein banti hai, magar is ki maujoodgi free radical substitution mechanism ka saboot hai.

book_ref.quote: Halogenation involves the following three steps.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ne methane ki misaal di hai jahan do methyl radicals mil kar ethane dete hain. Ethane ki chlorination mein yahi qadam do ethyl radicals se butane deta hai: 'dugne carbon wala alkane' hamesha radicals ke milne ki nishani hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 State the IUPAC rules for naming alkenes. Illustrate them by naming CH₃–CH₂–CH=CH–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ and (CH₃)₂CH–CH=CH₂. (4 marks)
(Alkenes ke naam rakhne ke IUPAC rules bayan karein. Inhein CH₃–CH₂–CH=CH–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ aur (CH₃)₂CH–CH=CH₂ ke naam se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alkenes C=C wale unsaturated hydrocarbons hain; in mein mutabiq alkanes se do hydrogen kam hote hain.

Rule 1: C=C wali sab se lambi musalsal chain ko parent chunein, aur utni lambi chain wale alkane ka -ane, -ene se badlein.
Rule 2: chain ki numbering aise karein ke double bond ke dono carbon shamil hon, aur double bond ke qareeb sire se shuru karein.
Rule 3: double bond ki jagah us ke pehle carbon ke number se prefix ke taur par dikhayein (1-butene, 1-pentene).
Rule 4: substituents ki jagah un carbons ke numbers se dikhayein jin se woh jure hain (2-methyl-2-butene).
Rule 5: aik se ziyada double bonds hon to naam alkadiene (do), alkatriene (teen) waghera.

Misalein: CH₃–CH₂–CH=CH–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃: saat carbon ki chain; baayen sire (C=C ke qareeb) se numbering double bond ko C-3 par rakhti hai: 3-heptene.
(CH₃)₂CH–CH=CH₂: C=C wali lambi chain chaar carbon ki; CH₂= se numbering double bond C-1 aur CH₃ C-3 par: 3-methyl-1-butene.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC rules for naming alkenes are similar in many respects to those for naming alkanes.

blocks.prompt:
12 What are elimination reactions? Explain how concentrated sulphuric acid converts ethanol into ethene, writing the equations for both stages, and state the role of the acid. (4 marks)
(Elimination reactions kya hain? Wazahat karein ke concentrated sulphuric acid ethanol ko ethene mein kaise badalta hai, dono marhalon ki equations ke saath, aur acid ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Elimination reactions: saturated compound ke saath wale carbon atoms se chhote atoms (H, OH, X) hata kar alkenes banaye jate hain aur carbons ke darmiyan double bond banta hai. H₂O ya HCl jaisa chhota molecule saath wale carbons se nikalta hai.

Ethanol ki dehydration: ethanol ko ziyada concentrated H₂SO₄ ke saath 180°C par garam kiya jata hai; alcohol molecule se water ka molecule nikalta hai. Majmooi:
CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O (H₂SO₄, garmi)

Marhala 1: ethyl hydrogen sulphate banta hai:
CH₃–CH₂OH + H₂SO₄ → CH₃–CH₂–OSO₃H + H₂O (180°C)

Marhala 2: ethyl hydrogen sulphate garam hone par toot kar ethene deta hai:
CH₃–CH₂OSO₃H → H₂C=CH₂ + H₂SO₄ (garmi)

H₂SO₄ ka kirdar: yeh water nikalta hai, intermediate ethyl hydrogen sulphate banata hai, aur marhala 2 mein wapas mil jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Alkenes are prepared by the removal of small atoms (H,OH,X) from the adjacent carbon atoms of the saturated compounds

blocks.prompt:
13 Compare alkanes and alkenes with respect to general formula, hybridization and shape, type of bonds, polarity, reactivity and the typical reactions they undergo. (4 marks)
(Alkanes aur alkenes ka muwazna karein: general formula, hybridization aur shakal, bonds ki qisam, polarity, reactivity aur un ke khaas reactions.)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes saturated aur be-amal hain; alkenes unsaturated hain, un mein π bond hai aur woh reactive hain.

book_ref.quote: Unlike alkanes, they show weakly polar properties because of sp² hybridization

rows: Unsaturated; alkane se do H kam (aik C=C).
Double-bond carbons sp²; trigonal planar, taqreeban 120°.
σ bonds aur C=C mein aik π bond.
sp² hybridization ki wajah se halke polar.
Aam halaat mein polar reagents se be-amal.
Reactive; dheele π electrons electrophiles ke liye khule.
Electrophilic addition; oxidation, combustion, polymerization bhi.
Jalte hain; C₁-C₄ gases, be-rang be-boo.
Khaas boo; roshan shole se jalte hain; C₂-C₄ gases.

blocks.prompt:
14 Explain the structure of ethene on the basis of sp² hybridization, describing the formation of the σ and π bonds and the shape of the molecule. (4 marks)
(sp² hybridization ki bunyad par ethene ki structure samjhayein: σ aur π bonds ka banna aur molecule ki shakal.)
blocks.explanation:
Hybridization: ethene (C₂H₄) sab se saada alkene hai. Har carbon apna 2s orbital do 2p orbitals se mila kar teen barabar sp² hybrid orbitals banata hai jo aik plane mein hain; aik unhybrid p-orbital is plane par amoodan (90°) bachta hai (Figure 11.8).

σ bonds: har carbon do sp² orbitals se hydrogen ke 1s orbitals ke saath do C–H σ bonds banata hai. Har carbon ka baqi sp² orbital linear overlap se C–C σ bond banata hai (Figure 11.9).

π bond: dono carbons ke unhybrid p-orbitals parallel hain aur pehlu se (laterally) overlap kar ke π bond banate hain; yani C=C mein aik σ aur aik π bond hai.

Shakal: sp² se har carbon ke gird trigonal planar tarteeb aur taqreeban 120° ke angles. Double bond ke do carbon aur un se jure chaar atoms aik plane mein hain, is liye ethene planar molecule hai (Figure 11.10).

book_ref.quote: In ethene, each carbon uses two sp² orbitals to form two C–H bonds each.

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain why alkenes are more reactive than alkanes and why they undergo electrophilic addition. Define electrophile and nucleophile, and explain why the reactions of alkenes depend on carbocations. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke alkenes alkanes se ziyada reactive kyun hain aur electrophilic addition kyun karte hain. Electrophile aur nucleophile ki definition dein aur batayein ke alkenes ke reactions carbocations par kyun munhasir hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Kamzor π bond: π bond mein electrons milne ka imkaan nuclei ko milane wali line se door hai, is liye π electrons kam mazbooti se pakre jate hain. π bond σ se kamzor hai aur reaction mein asaani se toot-ta hai. Alkanes mein sirf mazboot σ bonds hain.

2. Khule π electrons: dheele pakre π electrons electrophilic reagents ke hamle ke liye khule hain, is liye alkenes bohat asaani se electrophilic addition karte hain.

3. Definitions: electrophile (E⁺) electron pair lene wali species hai. Nucleophile (Nu:⁻) electrons ka jora dene wali species hai. Alkenes nucleophile hain kyun ke un mein π electrons hain.

4. Carbocations: jab π electrons electrophile par hamla karte hain to carbocation intermediate banta hai; alkenes ke reactions zyada tar carbocations se guzarte hain, is liye un ki stability product tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Moreover, the loosely held π-electrons are more exposed to attack by the electrophilic reagents.

blocks.prompt:
16 What is a carbocation? Classify carbocations with examples and explain, using the inductive effect of alkyl groups, the order of their stability. (4 marks)
(Carbocation kya hai? Carbocations ki darja-bandi misalon ke saath karein aur alkyl groups ke inductive effect se un ki stability ki tarteeb samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carbocation: aisa alkyl group jis ke aik carbon par aik positive charge ho. Is positive charge ki wajah se yeh electrophile hai.

Darja-bandi (positive carbon se jure carbons ke lihaaz se):
• Methyl carbocation, sirf H se jura: CH₃⁺
• Primary (1°), aik carbon se jura: CH₃CH₂⁺
• Secondary (2°), do carbons se jura: (CH₃)₂CH⁺
• Tertiary (3°), teen carbons se jura: (CH₃)₃C⁺

Inductive effect: saath wale groups ke electrons khainchne ya dene se σ bond ki polarization. Alkyl groups halke electron dene wale (+I) hain. Positive carbon se jure alkyl groups electrons us ki taraf dhakelte hain (bonds par arrowheads se dikhaya jata hai), is liye carbocation kam positive aur energy ke lihaaz se ziyada mustahkam hota hai.

Tarteeb: alkyl groups barhne se stability barhti hai: (CH₃)₃C⁺ > (CH₃)₂CH⁺ > CH₃CH₂⁺ > CH₃⁺. Teen electron dene wale alkyl groups ki wajah se tertiary carbocation sab se mustahkam hai (Figure 11.11).

book_ref.quote: The inductive effect of alkyl groups plays an important role in the stability of carbocation.

blocks.prompt:
17 Define the inductive effect. Explain the positive and negative inductive effects with examples, and describe the polarization of the σ bonds in a chloroalkane. (4 marks)
(Inductive effect ki definition dein. Positive aur negative inductive effects ki misalon ke saath wazahat karein aur chloroalkane mein σ bonds ki polarization bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: saath wale groups ya atoms ke electrons khainchne ya dene ki wajah se σ bond ki polarization inductive effect hai.

Positive inductive effect (+I): electron dene wali species dikhati hain, maslan alkyl groups. Positive carbon se jure alkyl groups electrons us ki taraf dhakel kar carbocations ko mustahkam karte hain; jitne ziyada alkyl groups, utna mustahkam carbocation.

Negative inductive effect (-I): electron khainchne wale groups dikhate hain, maslan halogen atom. Halogen carbon se bonded electrons apni taraf khainchta hai.

Chloroalkane C₂–C₁–Cl mein polarization (Figure 11.12): chlorine C₁–Cl bond ke electrons khainchta hai, is liye chlorine par juzwi negative aur C₁ par juzwi positive (δ⁺) charge aata hai. C₁ aage C₂–C₁ bond ke electrons khainchta hai, is liye C₂ par kam positive charge (δδ⁺) hota hai. Molecule mein mustaqil dipole banta hai; asar chain mein aage kamzor hota jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Halogen withdraws bonded electrons from carbon to carbon bond and thus displays negative inductive effect.

blocks.prompt:
18 How is bromine used to test for unsaturation? Describe the three-step mechanism of the addition of bromine to ethene. (4 marks)
(Unsaturation ke test ke liye bromine kaise istemal hoti hai? Ethene par bromine ke addition ka teen qadmon wala mechanism bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Test: jab ethene mein carbon tetrachloride jaise inert solvent mein bromine (surkhi-maail bhoori) dali jaye to us ka rang foran khatam ho jata hai. Yeh reaction organic compound ki unsaturation pehchanne ke liye hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + Br₂ → Br–CH₂–CH₂–Br

Mechanism (Figure 11.14):
Qadam (i) Br₂ ki polarization: Br₂ non-polar hai, magar C=C ke qareeb aane par double bond ki ziyada electron density Br–Br ke electron pair ko qareeb wale Br se door dhakelti hai. Woh Br juzwi positive (Brᵟ⁺–Brᵟ⁻) ho kar electrophile ban jata hai.

Qadam (ii) Electrophilic hamla: double bond ke π electrons δ⁺ bromine par hamla karte hain aur woh C=C se electron pair le leta hai. Br–Br bond heterolytically toot kar Br⁻ aur bohat reactive carbocation intermediate CH₂Br–CH₂⁺ deta hai.

Qadam (iii) Nucleophilic hamla: carbocation Br⁻ (nucleophile) se react kar ke product Br–CH₂–CH₂–Br deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The above reaction proceeds through a three–steps mechanism as given below:

blocks.prompt:
19 Using carbocation stability, explain why HBr adds to 2-methylpropene, (CH₃)₂C=CH₂, to give mainly 2-bromo-2-methylpropane. Write the steps of the mechanism. (4 marks)
(Carbocation stability ki madad se wazahat karein ke HBr 2-methylpropene, (CH₃)₂C=CH₂, par jur kar zyada tar 2-bromo-2-methylpropane kyun deta hai. Mechanism ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
2-Methylpropene unsymmetrical alkene hai, is liye nazariyati taur par do products mumkin hain. Markovnikov's rule: jab polar reagent unsymmetrical alkene par jurta hai to us ka negative hissa kam hydrogen wale double-bond carbon par jurta hai.

Qadam 1 (electrophilic hamla): H–Br polar hai (Hᵟ⁺–Brᵟ⁻). C=C ke π electrons juzwi positive H par hamla karte hain; HBr heterolytically toot kar Br⁻ deta hai. Do carbocations mumkin hain:
(a) H CH₂ (ziyada hydrogen wale carbon) par jure: (CH₃)₂C⁺–CH₃, yani (CH₃)₃C⁺, tertiary (3°) carbocation.
(b) H doosre carbon par jure: (CH₃)₂CH–CH₂⁺, primary (1°) carbocation.

Stability: 3° carbocation ke positive carbon par teen electron dene wale (+I) alkyl groups hain, is liye yeh bohat ziyada mustahkam hai aur zyada tar yahi banta hai.

Qadam 2 (nucleophilic hamla): Br⁻ (nucleophile) 3° carbocation par hamla karta hai:
(CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻ → (CH₃)₃C–Br, 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (major).
1° carbocation par hamle se minor product (CH₃)₂CH–CH₂Br, 1-bromo-2-methylpropane banta hai. Br kam hydrogen wale carbon par gaya, jaisa rule kehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Markovnikov’s Rule is applicable for addition reactions in alkenes.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book ne propene ki misaal di hai (2° carbocation se 2-bromopropane). Yahan wohi usool hai: H us carbon par jaata hai jis par ziyada H hain, taake positive charge ziyada alkyl groups wale carbon par aaye; 3° carbocation 1° se kahin ziyada mustahkam hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 Describe the hydrogenation, hydration and halohydration of ethene, giving the conditions, equations and products, and one industrial use of hydrogenation. (4 marks)
(Ethene ki hydrogenation, hydration aur halohydration bayan karein: halaat, equations, products, aur hydrogenation ka aik industrial istemal.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hydrogenation: Ni/Pt catalyst ki maujoodgi mein 250-300 °C par alkene par molecular hydrogen ka jurna, jis se saturated compound banta hai.
H₂C=CH₂ + H₂ → H₃C–CH₃ (Ni, 250-300 °C)
Industrial istemal: vegetable oil ko margarine (Banaspati ghee) banaya jata hai: Oil + H₂ → Margarine (Ni).

2. Hydration: gaseous alkenes ziyada temperature aur pressure par concentrated H₂SO₄ catalyst ke saath steam se react kar ke alcohols banate hain.
H₂C=CH₂ + H₂O → C₂H₅OH (H₂SO₄)
Hydrohalogenation ki tarah alkene carbocation intermediate banati hai jis par hamla ho kar alcohol banta hai.

3. Halohydration: alkene water ki maujoodgi mein halogen (bromine ya chlorine) se react kar ke halohydrin banati hai. Br aur OH double bond ke do carbons par jurte hain:
H₂C=CH₂ + Br₂ + H₂O → Br–CH₂–CH₂–OH + HBr
Product: 2-bromoethanol (ethylene bromohydrin); chlorine se chlorohydrin banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Gaseous alkenes react with steam at high temperature and pressure in the presence of concentrated acid (H₂SO₄) as the catalyst to form alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is addition polymerization? Explain how the bonding changes when ethene and chloroethene polymerize, and how the repeating unit of a poly(alkene) is deduced from its monomer. (4 marks)
(Addition polymerization kya hai? Wazahat karein ke ethene aur chloroethene ki polymerization mein bonding kaise badalti hai, aur poly(alkene) ka repeating unit monomer se kaise nikala jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Polymerization: chhote reactive molecules (monomers) ke aapas mein jur kar bohat lambe molecules (polymers) banana.

Addition polymerization: kam az kam aik C=C wale bohat se monomers lambi polymer chains banate hain aur koi doosra product nahi banta. Yeh plastics industry ki bunyad hai.

Bonding ki tabdeeli: doosre addition reactions ki tarah har C=C ka π bond toot-ta hai aur monomers naye C–C single bonds se jurte hain.
n CH₂=CH₂ → [–CH₂–CH₂–]ₙ  poly(ethene)
n CH₂=CHCl → [–CH₂–CHCl–]ₙ  PVC (har doosre carbon par Cl)

Repeating unit: atoms ka sab se chhota group jo aik ke baad aik jur kar polymer chain banata hai; ise square brackets mein dikhaya jata hai. Aik monomer se bane poly(alkene) ka repeating unit monomer jaisa hi hai, sirf C=C, C–C single bond ban jata hai.

Istemal: polyethylene thailon, botalon aur packaging mein; PVC ball pen jaisi cheezon mein.

book_ref.quote: A polymer is a long-chain molecule that is made up of many repeating units.

blocks.prompt:
22 What are conjugated dienes? Explain the delocalization of π electrons in them, give two examples and state their industrial importance. (4 marks)
(Conjugated dienes kya hain? In mein π electrons ki delocalization samjhayein, do misalein dein aur un ki industrial ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diene: aisa molecule jis mein carbon atoms ke darmiyan do double bonds hon. Conjugated diene mein carbon chain ke double bonds aik single bond se alag hote hain.

Delocalization: saath saath double bonds teen ya ziyada saath wale atoms par p-orbitals ki overlap mumkin banate hain. Is overlap se π electrons phail (delocalize) jate hain aur π-bond ki overlap poore system par hoti hai. Delocalization molecule ko mustahkam aur us ki reactivity ko mutasir kar sakti hai.

Misalein:
CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂  but-1,3-diene (1,3-butadiene)
CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂  2-methylbut-1,3-diene (isoprene)

Ahmiyat: 1,3-butadiene jaise conjugated dienes synthetic rubber banane mein kaam aate hain; conjugated banawat polymerization se lambi chains deti hai jo rubber jaisi khasusiyat dikhati hain.

book_ref.quote: This overlap leads to a delocalization of electrons, which can stabilize the molecule and affect its reactivity.

blocks.prompt:
23 Define isomerism. Explain chain, position and functional group isomerism with one example of each. (4 marks)
(Isomerism ki definition dein. Chain, position aur functional group isomerism ko aik aik misaal ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Isomerism: do ya ziyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik magar structural formula aur khasusiyat mukhtalif hon, isomers kehlate hain aur yeh amal isomerism hai. Teen se ziyada carbon wale compounds mein yeh aam hai; carbon barhne se isomers tezi se barhte hain (pentane ke teen). Structural isomerism molecule mein atoms ki tarteeb ke farq se hota hai.

1. Chain isomerism: carbon chain ki noiyat ke farq se.
Misaal (C₄H₁₀): CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (butane) aur CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₃ (2-methylpropane).

2. Position isomerism: aik hi functional group ki carbon chain par jagah ke farq se; carbon atoms ki tarteeb wohi rehti hai.
Misaal (C₄H₈): CH₂=CH–CH₂–CH₃ (but-1-ene) aur CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃ (but-2-ene); isi tarah 1-chloropropane aur 2-chloropropane.

3. Functional group isomerism: molecular formula aik magar functional groups mukhtalif.
Misaal (C₂H₆O): CH₃–CH₂–OH (ethanol, alcohol) aur CH₃–O–CH₃ (methoxymethane, ether).

book_ref.quote: As the number of carbon atoms in a hydrocarbon increases, the number of possible isomers increase very rapidly.

blocks.prompt:
24 Explain metamerism and tautomerism with examples. Name the two types of stereoisomerism and state how stereoisomers differ from structural isomers. (4 marks)
(Metamerism aur tautomerism ko misalon ke saath samjhayein. Stereoisomerism ki do qismon ke naam likhein aur batayein ke stereoisomers structural isomers se kaise mukhtalif hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Metamerism: functional group ke dono taraf carbon atoms ki na-barabar taqseem se hota hai; metamers aik hi homologous series ke hote hain.
Ethers (C₄H₁₀O): CH₃CH₂–O–CH₂CH₃ (ethoxyethane, diethyl ether) aur CH₃–O–CH₂CH₂CH₃ (methoxypropane).
Ketones (C₅H₁₀O): CH₃–CO–CH₂CH₂CH₃ (2-pentanone) aur CH₃CH₂–CO–CH₂CH₃ (3-pentanone).

2. Tautomerism: aik hi molecule mein proton ke aik atom se doosre par jaane se hota hai. Yeh amino acids mein aam hai jo zwitterions ki surat mein hote hain; zwitterion tab banta hai jab proton carboxylic acid wale sire se amine group par chala jaye.

3. Stereoisomerism: stereoisomers ka structural formula aik hai magar aik jaise groups ki space mein jagah mukhtalif hai (structural isomers ke structural formule mukhtalif hote hain). Do qismein: geometrical (cis-trans) aur optical isomerism; yeh Class 12 ke syllabus mein hain.

book_ref.quote: This type of isomerism arises due to the unequal distribution of carbon atoms on either side of the functional group.

blocks.prompt:
25 What are organic redox reactions? Describe, with equations, the oxidation of organic compounds (combustion, ozonolysis, epoxidation, oxidation of a primary alcohol) and their reduction (hydrogenation and the use of reducing agents). (4 marks)
(Organic redox reactions kya hain? Equations ke saath organic compounds ki oxidation (combustion, ozonolysis, epoxidation, primary alcohol ki oxidation) aur reduction (hydrogenation aur reducing agents ka istemal) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Organic redox reactions: woh oxidation-reduction reactions jin mein organic compounds hon. In ki pehchan atoms/bonds ka jurna ya nikalna hai. Organic oxidation mein oxygen jurti ya hydrogen nikalti hai; organic reduction mein hydrogen jurti ya oxygen nikalti hai.

Oxidation:
• Combustion (oxygen se reaction): 2C₂H₆ + 7O₂ → 4CO₂ + 6H₂O (C₂H₆ + 7/2 O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O).
• Ozonolysis: ozone (O₃) se alkene ka oxidation se tootna, ozonide ke zariye carbonyl compounds, maslan C₂H₄ + O₃ → C₂H₄O₃ → 2CH₂O.
• Epoxidation: molecular oxygen aur metal catalysts jaise oxidizing agents se alkene epoxide deti hai (ethene → ethylene oxide).
• Primary alcohol acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se carboxylic acid deta hai: C₂H₅OH + 2[O] → CH₃COOH + H₂O.

Reduction:
• C=C ki hydrogenation: H₂C=CH₂ + H–H → H₃C–CH₃ (Pt).
• Organic synthesis mein reducing agents: LiAlH₄, NaBH₄, Sn + conc. HCl, maslan CH₃–CHO + 2[H] → CH₃–CH₂–OH (LiAlH₄, garmi). Nitriles aur amides se amines, carboxylic acids se primary alcohols aur nitrobenzene se phenylamine ki reduction Class 12 mein parhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxidation-Reduction reactions that involve organic compounds are called organic redox reactions.
